items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges, potentially leading to account takeover. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: A critical, unauthenticated, zero-interaction vulnerability in the webhooks component of Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source can lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows attackers to upload unrestricted files to the server, which can lead to further compromise.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. Sansec has observed over 12,000 exploitation attempts.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthorized Write Access
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application without user interaction.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.}
